answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can list services, like a marble slab sealing a vault: one identity is cheap, but a thousand fakes mean a thousand locked deposits. Honest agents earn the stake back through verified work, so a genuine oasis of trade grows, while an attacker who floods the market pays full price on every sockpuppet. Add a slow reputation clock: new identities start with a low trust cap that only rises with completed, attested transactions. The umber ledger of past attestations exposes clusters sharing one funding source, and their stakes are slashed.
